checks.name: S0 su(N) basis normalised Tr(T^a T^b) = delta/2
S1a SU(2): ALL 27 symmetric anomaly coefficients are EXACTLY zero => a chiral doublet is allowed
S1b SU(3): A^{888} = -1/sqrt(3) exactly, nonzero => a chiral triplet is NOT allowed
S1c among {vector-like, chiral, conjugate} ONLY the vector-like colour assignment is anomaly-free
S2a vector-like => the branch-space coupling is a SCALAR (traceless part exactly 0) => F68/F91 even law FORCED
S2b ... and the contrast is real: a chiral colour would split the branches by |dOmega|/2 on the body diagonal
S3a a CA rule is ONE operator per cell, so a SITE-DEPENDENT V(x) commutes with the on-site step exactly (F27's U(x) is pure gauge for this reason)
S3b the HOP compares two cells, so covariance fails at O(1) with no compensator
S3c U_mu -> V(x) U_mu V^dag(x+mu) restores it exactly => the gluon field is FORCED by locality
S3d the same three legs on the TREE's own SU(3) operators (strong.py), not a toy
S4a the model's own steps generate the FULL M_4 on the Dirac factor (otherwise the commutant would be big for a trivial reason), and the re-typed walk IS unitary
S4b the commutant of the rule is M_3 (dim 9) => the invariance group is exactly U(3)
S4c corollary and PREDICTION: the spectrum is exactly 3-fold degenerate
S5a [SU(2)_L]^2 U(1)_Y is IDENTICALLY zero in N_c on the model's own nullspace
S5b [SU(2)_L]^2 U(1)_trace = N_c b / 2 != 0 => the U(1) factor of U(N_c) CANNOT be gauged => colour is SU(N_c)
S5c only ONE abelian direction exists (nullspace dim 1, F279/F293) and it is already spent on Y
S5d on the model's OWN content the cubic SU(N)^3 anomaly cancels 2 - 2, and A(fund) itself is NONZERO so this is a statement about the content
S5e the mixed SU(N)^2 U(1)_Y anomaly 2y_Q - (y_u + y_d) vanishes IDENTICALLY in N_c on the model's own nullspace (y_u = N_c+1, y_d = 1-N_c)
S6a Lambda^3(C^N) carries an SU(N) singlet at EXACTLY one N, and it is 3 (scan N = 2..6)
S6b ... so a three-constituent totally antisymmetric singlet exists at N = 3
S7 dim su(3) = 8 gluons and the algebra closes on f^abc

B1_colour_derived: unitary: the rule is R (x) 1_N, commutant = M_N, group = U(N)
special: [SU(2)_L]^2 U(1)_trace != 0 removes the U(1) factor
local: a CA rule has no global operations, so V(x) is free on-site and the hop needs a compensator = the gluon
vector-like: a chiral triplet has A^{888} = -1/sqrt(3) != 0, while a chiral doublet is anomaly-free -- so the model's chiral weak / vector strong split is forced, not chosen
even propagation law: F91's one unforced assignment closes
B1_colour_still_input: THAT the quark carries an internal index at all
summary.B10_touched_only_here: S6 gives N = 3 exactly from Lambda^3 having a singlet at exactly one N, GIVEN three-constituent baryons (empirical) and DERIVED Fermi statistics (F289).  It is not one of B10's three closed routes and does not re-open them.  It is independent of, and agrees with, F298's structural N_c <= 3.
